description: Preset lifecycle: the GPU preset library (originals and working copies), Apply (full load) and save.

commands.name: preset.list
commands.title: List library presets
commands.description: The preset library entry records ({name, kind original|working, source, path}) and the active entry.

commands.name: preset.load
commands.title: Apply (load) a preset
commands.description: Initialises the engine from a preset file with the given load settings. A HOT change (volume / feedback only) keeps the engine; a STRUCTURAL change (path, array_size, sample_rate, iterations, driver, buffer, audio_on, debug) is a full reload that stops audio. `volume` here is the preset level anchor, NOT the slider level. Every load setting you OMIT keeps the live engine's value (preset.load_settings lists them), so {path} alone reloads with the user's current settings; only with no engine loaded are sample_rate / string_iterations / audio_on / start_right_away required. The response lists inherited_load_params and load_param_warnings (settings that differ from what the preset declares).

path.description: Preset JSON path relative to pianoid_middleware (e.g. presets/BaselinePreset1.json)

audio_driver_type.description: 0 SDL3 default, 1 ASIO, 2 SDL auto, 3 SDL3, 4 ASIO_CALLBACK

volume.description: Preset level anchor (default 100), not the slider level

commands.name: preset.save
commands.title: Save the active preset
commands.description: Writes the ACTIVE library entry to a JSON file (.json appended when missing). Saving onto a loaded original's file refreshes that original.

commands.name: preset.load_to_library
commands.title: Load a preset into the library
commands.description: Loads a preset file as a read-only original library entry without activating it (it must share the running engine's string layout).

commands.name: preset.switch
commands.title: Switch the active preset
commands.description: Atomic switch to a library entry; playback continues. Leaving a working copy saves its live edits to its slot.

commands.name: preset.spawn_working_copy
commands.title: Spawn a working copy
commands.description: Creates an editable working copy of a library entry (its current state, live edits included).

commands.name: preset.promote
commands.title: Promote a working copy
commands.description: Overwrites the source original's JSON file on disk with the working copy (permanent).

commands.name: preset.unload
commands.title: Unload a library preset
commands.description: Removes a library entry (the last one cannot be unloaded); unloading the active entry switches first.

commands.name: preset.load_settings
commands.title: Read the live load settings
commands.description: The settings the running engine was loaded with, in preset.load form (sample_rate Hz, string_iterations, sound_derivative_order, array_size, listen_to_modes, audio_driver_type, volume = the load level anchor, ...), what the loaded preset declares it needs (declared) and the differences (mismatches). preset.load keeps every setting you omit at these live values.

commands.name: preset.summary
commands.title: Summarise a library preset
commands.description: One library entry (default: the active one): kind, source, path, editable, its in-memory model parameters (num_modes, num_strings, num_channels, listen_to_modes, sr, array_size, output_scale state, ...), the file header (piano pitch range, declared load params, provenance such as fpga_conversion), undo_depth (edits in the backend history) and, for the active entry, the live load settings with the mismatches. 404 lists the entries.

entry.description: library entry name (preset.list); default the active entry

commands.name: preset.files
commands.title: List the preset files on disk
commands.description: The preset JSON files under the allow-listed preset root (pianoid_middleware/presets, two levels deep, at most 200): file, size, mtime and a cheap header (num_modes, num_strings, num_channels, listen_to_modes, piano pitch range, declared load params, provenance). load_path is the path preset.load / preset.load_to_library take. Never any other folder.

commands.name: preset.create
commands.title: Create a preset with a new structure
commands.description: Writes a NEW preset presets/<name>.json from a base preset with the given number of strings, output channels (exciters), array_size and (optionally fewer) modes: removes unison strings (treble_first / bass_first), re-packs the blocks, rebuilds the output pitches 128.. and scales the string geometry to array_size; refuses when a block does not fit. The new channels copy the base's first output row (set real weights with modal.rig_process build_preset). Never overwrites unless overwrite: true. Output scale must be re-derived after loading. Long-running: returns a jobId.

num_strings.description: Total strings incl. the output strings (a multiple of the strings per block, 4)

num_modes.description: 0 = keep the base's modes; else keep the first N

string_removal.description: Which unisons lose a string first (3-string unisons before 2-string ones)

commands.name: preset.add_thump
commands.title: Add the keybed thump string to a new preset
commands.description: Writes a NEW preset presets/<name>.json from a source preset with the keybed thump string added (Pianoid.thump_string): a short light string on a non-key pitch that every key note-on also strikes. The source must exist and stays unchanged; name must not exist (there is no overwrite); a source that already has the pitch, or has no padding string on its output pitches, is refused. rho is derived from the source's string_iteration. File work only, the engine is not touched: load the result with preset.load. Long-running: returns a jobId.

name.description: New preset name (letters, digits, . _ -); must not exist

pitch.description: Thump pitch: a non-key id, 0-20 or 109-127

deck_from.description: Key pitch whose deck row the thump string copies

deck_scale.description: Scale of the copied deck row

max_mode_hz.description: Zero the deck row above this frequency (250 = the low-mode rim row); 0 = keep the whole row

enable.description: Thump on in the new preset; false = present but off
